name: say-so
description: SaySo: low-latency Cloudflare-native spoken-intent authorization returning signed Ed25519 verdicts.

scripts.build: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @seams/sayso-demo build
scripts.test:ts: pnpm --filter @seams/sayso-verdict test && pnpm --filter @seams/sayso-client test && pnpm --filter @seams/sayso-verifier-worker test
scripts.test: pnpm build:wasm && pnpm build:packages && pnpm test:rust && pnpm test:ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @seams/sayso-verdict type-check && pnpm --filter @seams/sayso-client type-check && pnpm --filter @seams/sayso-verifier-worker type-check && pnpm --filter @seams/sayso-demo type-check
